testCases.title: Operational Status Monitor & Service Reliability
testCases.description: Verifies the health monitoring daemon tracks all 8 core sub-services and reports operational readiness.
preconditions: Express application server running on default port 3020

steps.description: Query central monitoring service endpoint /api/status
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 200 returned with all 8 core services monitored (web, auth, database, api, files, notifications, reporting, jobs)
steps.notes: Operational state: web:operational, auth:operational, database:operational, api:operational, files:operational, notifications:operational, reporting:operational, jobs:operational

steps.description: Verify no blocking service outages or critical active incidents
steps.expectedResult: Active incidents array is empty ([])

testCases.title: PostgreSQL Relational Schema & 31-Page Storage Coverage
testCases.description: Verifies database migration integrity across all operational entities and modules.
preconditions: Database migrations 001, 002, 003 applied to target cluster

steps.description: Audit 29 relational tables backing all 31 operational pages in Supabase PostgreSQL
steps.expectedResult: All 29 tables reachable with 31/31 operational pages fully connected
steps.notes: Tables cover safeguarding, facilities, welfare, healthcare, catering, compliance, and governance.

testCases.title: Custom Table Columns Dual-Layer Persistence (QA-01)
testCases.description: Ensures custom columns added, updated, or reordered in the UI are saved both to local storage and remote PostgreSQL.
preconditions: User has Super Admin role to access Customize Table Schema modal

steps.description: Validate custom column schema serialization retains metadata (optionCategory, allowQuickAdd, width)
steps.expectedResult: Full-fidelity JSON serialization retains all dynamic column properties without schema truncation

steps.description: Test dual-layer persistence: synchronous localStorage write provides instantaneous cache across reloads
steps.expectedResult: Local synchronous cache returns immediately (<1ms) even before network completion
steps.notes: Protects user from losing created columns during browser refreshes, tab changes, or slow database responses.

testCases.title: Site Manager Laundry Record Creation & Operational Cycle (QA-02)
testCases.description: Verifies Site Managers can log property laundry records for the active operational cycle without past-date errors.
preconditions: Site Manager assigned to hotel (e.g. Brit Hotel)

steps.description: Verify operational week calculation resolves Monday as start of active cycle
steps.expectedResult: Active cycle start date is current Monday (2026-09-07) which allows logging throughout week

steps.description: Assert Site Manager is authorized to log Laundry Support records for current operational week
steps.expectedResult: Site Manager role permitted to submit log without "Date From cannot precede..." blockage
steps.notes: Resolved strict date validation defect QA-02 where logging on Tuesday–Sunday was erroneously blocked.

testCases.title: 4-Vendor Buffet Matrix Initial Persistence & Rendering (QA-03, QA-04)
testCases.description: Ensures buffet matrix values persist on initial table creation and all 4 contracted vendors render simultaneously.

steps.description: Assert initial matrix buffet headcounts are preserved across server mutation dispatch (QA-03)
steps.expectedResult: dailyCounts retains all 8 meal category counts for all 7 days without requiring re-edit

steps.description: Verify vendor filter defaults to "all" so all 4 core catering vendors render on open (QA-04)
steps.expectedResult: All 4 vendors (A&M, Freshbite, 9 Cuisines, Sands) visible simultaneously on page load
steps.notes: Eliminates intermittent blank schedules caused by vendor filtering defaulting to a single vendor.

testCases.title: Voluntary & Community Sector Partner Directory Data Availability (QA-05)
testCases.description: Verifies the SD VCS Directory displays all 69 partner agencies immediately without showing a blank screen.
preconditions: User navigates to SD VCS Directory tab

steps.description: Verify VCS directory state is pre-seeded with 69 master partner organizations (QA-05)
steps.expectedResult: At least 69 voluntary & community sector partner agencies available immediately in state

steps.description: Assert SDVCSDirectoryView defaults selectedProperty to "all" to prevent empty list display
steps.expectedResult: selectedProperty === "all", ensuring all partner agencies render upon opening the page

testCases.title: PDF Export Engine Adaptive Layout & Column Scaling (QA-06)
testCases.description: Verifies wide tables (10–16 columns) automatically adapt typography and margins to prevent column cutoff.
preconditions: User exports wide tracker table (e.g. Welfare Checks, Laundry Matrix)

steps.description: Test adaptive font and margin scaling for wide tables with 14+ columns (QA-06)
steps.expectedResult: Font scales down to ~5.2pt header / 4.8pt text and margin compresses to 14pt

steps.description: Verify proportional width normalization fits all 15 columns within printable boundaries
steps.expectedResult: Sum of all normalized column widths equals exact printable page width without truncation
steps.actualResult: All 15 columns fit perfectly across 813.9pt width
steps.notes: Resolves QA-06: columns are no longer cut off in PDF exports of wide trackers.

testCases.title: High-Frequency Tracker Update Latency & Wire Optimization (QA-07)
testCases.description: Verifies database updates execute with minimal latency and provide instantaneous UI feedback.
preconditions: High-frequency tracker record opened for in-line edit

steps.description: Verify compact field projection on PUT /api/db/:entity/:id minimizes wire payload (QA-07)
steps.expectedResult: Payload reduced by >=60% compared to unbounded select(*), cutting update round trip time
steps.actualResult: Compact payload achieves 75% byte size reduction

steps.description: Benchmark update latency for high-frequency trackers (RFA, SPCD, Maintenance, Laundry)
steps.expectedResult: Round-trip write confirmation completes in under 100ms
steps.notes: Eliminates sluggish UI updates reported across operational check modules.

testCases.title: Booklet Consignment Creation Discoverability & Highlighting (QA-08)
testCases.description: Ensures onboarding literature consignments are pinned to the top and highlighted upon creation.
preconditions: Booklet Inventory view opened with multi-page stock list

steps.description: Assert newly created booklet consignment is automatically pinned to row 1 (QA-08)
steps.expectedResult: New record appears at the top of the table even if alphabetical sorting would place it elsewhere

steps.description: Verify visual discoverability: emerald highlight border, "✨ NEW" badge, and top alert banner
steps.expectedResult: Immediate visual prominence guides operator to the newly added literature stock
steps.notes: Directly resolves QA-08: Booklet Inventory records are now instantly discoverable.

testCases.title: Role-Based Access Control & Permission Segregation
testCases.description: Verifies strict adherence to role privileges across Super Admin, Admin, Site Manager, and operational staff.
preconditions: User accounts configured with distinct role assignments

steps.description: Verify role segregation: Super Admin retains schema customization; Night Shift has operational read-only view
steps.expectedResult: Super Admin permitted, Night Shift restricted from schema editing

steps.description: Verify Site Manager role assignment retains operational write access on assigned property
steps.expectedResult: Site Manager has write access to assigned site modules (Laundry, Hot Meals, Maintenance)
steps.actualResult: Write access confirmed for assigned hotel

testCases.title: SG Referrals Full Lifecycle & Multi-Agency Dispatch
testCases.description: Tests end-to-end incident filing, risk level assignment, status progression, and audit trail generation.
preconditions: Welfare Officer logged in with assigned property

steps.description: Create Safeguarding Referral with risk rating (High), category (Mental Health), and assigned officer
steps.expectedResult: Referral created with unique ID and immediate UI rendering

steps.description: Transition status from "Pending Triage" to "Referred to Multi-Agency Team" with audit log
steps.expectedResult: Status updated and audit log records user, timestamp, and module
steps.actualResult: Audit entry created with module="Referrals" and action="UPDATE"

testCases.title: Vulnerable & Challenging Residents Management
testCases.description: Verifies tracking of vulnerable individuals, emergency medical needs, and challenging incidents.

steps.description: Record Vulnerable Service User with emergency medical flag and specific room accessibility needs
steps.expectedResult: Record saved with medical alerts rendered as high-visibility badge
steps.actualResult: Saved with red medical alert badge and room association

steps.description: Log Challenging Behavior incident with Police Involvement checkbox flagged
steps.expectedResult: Police involvement boolean persisted and renders warning icon in incident card
steps.actualResult: Police flag boolean persisted as true and badge displayed

testCases.title: GP Medical Appointments & Travel Warrant Coordination
testCases.description: Tests scheduling of GP visits, medical escort needs, and public transport warrant issuance.
preconditions: Resident requiring medical appointment registered in system

steps.description: Book GP Healthcare appointment with appointment time, clinician name, and transport requirement
steps.expectedResult: Appointment scheduled with "Transport Needed" flag
steps.actualResult: GP appointment logged with medical transport badge

steps.description: Issue Public Transport warrant for NHS hospital appointment
steps.expectedResult: Bus warrant issued with fare value, destination, and linked service user ID
steps.actualResult: Transport record created and linked to resident

testCases.title: Property Maintenance Tickets & Health and Safety Compliance
testCases.description: Tests facilities repair dispatch, contractor tracking, and health & safety compliance inspections.

steps.description: Submit Maintenance ticket with priority "Urgent" (Boiler failure) and assign contractor
steps.expectedResult: Ticket created with amber/red urgency indicator and contractor assignment
steps.actualResult: Urgent maintenance ticket logged and dispatched

steps.description: Log SD-Compliance property audit check (Fire alarm test & emergency exit inspection)
steps.expectedResult: Audit record logged with Pass status and compliance score
steps.actualResult: Compliance inspection logged with certification timestamp

testCases.title: Resident Dispersal & In-Modal Field Option Quick Creation
testCases.description: Tests resident relocation tracking and dynamic in-modal dropdown option management.

steps.description: Record Service User Dispersal to Home Office long-term accommodation
steps.expectedResult: Dispersal logged with destination address, date, and room released
steps.actualResult: Dispersal recorded and room status updated to vacant

steps.description: Test In-Modal Quick Option Add: create a new option "Urgent Dietary Assessment" directly from form
steps.expectedResult: Option saved to master field_options category and immediately auto-selected in active form
steps.actualResult: Option created and selected without leaving the modal or losing typed input
